Figures on this page

Checked: 25 June 2026

Numbers on this page are public-record leads. Crime, migration, sexual-offence, payout, death, and crisis figures must be tied to named official, court, police, parliamentary, regulator, or reputable source records before they are presented as settled.

Evidence standard

What counts as a usable figure?

Official statistics, court records, ministry releases, police datasets, parliamentary material, regulator data, or clearly named public reports. Nationality, foreign-born status, asylum status, immigration status, charge, suspect, conviction, and victim categories must not be mixed.

When the figure matters, follow the document link, source file, court record, official release, PDF, book, or video. The visible page should help readers reach the underlying evidence fast.

Civil, regulatory, sanctions and administrative actions are distinct from criminal convictions and may be resolved without admissions.

Open Predators in PowerSubmit Evidence
Classification rules, corrections and right of reply
  • A conviction label requires an adjudicated criminal outcome from an authoritative source.
  • Charges, indictments, complaints, arrests and investigations are not proof of guilt.
  • Civil and regulatory actions must not be described as criminal convictions.
  • Dismissals, acquittals, reversals, withdrawals, pardons, denials and right-of-reply statements must be preserved alongside the underlying claim.
  • Rumor and speculation require an attributable public origin, a reason for inclusion, counter-evidence, proof needed and an explicit not-established boundary.
  • Association, contact, employment, family relationship, board membership or proximity alone cannot establish wrongdoing.
  • Anonymous or unsourced allegations must not be published.
  • Every record requires a source URL, source label, date, status, evidence grade, last-checked date and boundary statement.
  • Predators in Power publication additionally requires explicit record eligibility, qualifying conduct tags, victim class, and at least one independently sourced qualifying power or influence role.
  • The Predators in Power page title is an accountability project label, not a blanket legal conclusion about every listed subject.

Corrections, updated dispositions and documented responses must be added to the same subject record rather than silently replacing earlier history. Registry checked 2026-07-27.
